title: TermLoop PM control protocol
$comment: Local single-user PM daemon control plane. Terminal bytes of PM agent sessions never travel here: the daemon serves them on its binary data plane with modules/terminal-wire framing exactly as the developer daemon does, keyed by the sessionId these methods return. Secrets only enter through pm_credential_store and are never returned; sources carry credential handle names only. PM agent MCP tools are defined by modules/pm, not by this schema.

pmAgentCatalog.$comment: The providers, models, and permission modes the PM agent may launch with, read from the agent catalog. Delivery checks run unattended, so their permission list holds only modes that never wait for a human.
